import cv2,pandas as pd,numpy as np
d=pd.read_csv('/tmp/out/demo_metadata.csv'); o=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv')
im=cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png');H,W=im.shape[:2];cnt=np.zeros((H,W),int)
for i,r in d.iterrows():
  xs=np.array(r.coords_x.split(','),int);ys=np.array(r.coords_y.split(','),int)
  m=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8);cv2.fillPoly(m,[np.stack([xs,ys],1)],1);cnt+=m
  n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m);assert n==2
  assert (xs.min(),xs.max(),ys.min(),ys.max())==(r.xmin,r.xmax,r.ymin,r.ymax)
  fr=m.sum()/((xs.max()-xs.min()+1)*(ys.max()-ys.min()+1)); assert fr<0.95,(i,fr)
  cv2.polylines(im,[np.stack([xs,ys],1)],True,(0,255,0) if o.type[i]=='polyline' else (0,0,255),1)
print('max overlap',cnt.max(), 'min pts', d.coords_x.str.count(',').min())
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/viz_out.png',cv2.resize(im,None,fx=2,fy=2))
EOF
